name: rpl_malloc
brief:
Replacement malloc/realloc for non-GNU systems

Provides rpl_malloc, rpl_calloc, and rpl_realloc as fallbacks when
the system's malloc implementation is not GNU-compatible (e.g., on
some embedded systems or older Unix variants).

Only used internally when HAVE_MALLOC or HAVE_REALLOC are not set
during autoconf configuration.

@note Internal header; not for direct use
